form.label: Claude Enterprise - Security Audit
form.description: Authentication, administrative changes, data exports, and file activity from the Compliance API activity feed. Requires the Compliance Activity Feed input.

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" (event_type=user_signed_in_* OR event_type="user_signed_in" OR event_type=user_signed_out) | stats count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" (event_type=org_sso_* OR event_type=org_jit_* OR event_type=org_domain_* OR event_type=org_user_deleted OR event_type=admin_api_key_*) | stats count
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" | where isnotnull(event_type) AND event_type!="" | timechart span=1d limit=15 useother=true count by event_type
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" | where isnotnull(actor_type) AND actor_type!="" | stats count by actor_type | sort - count
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" | where isnotnull(event_type) AND event_type!="" | stats count by event_type | sort - count | head 15

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" (event_type=user_signed_in_* OR event_type="user_signed_in") | `claude_actor_email` | where isnotnull(actor_email) OR isnotnull(actor_user_id) | stats count earliest(_time) AS first_seen latest(_time) AS last_seen by actor_email, actor_ip_address | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

panel.title: Users Signing In from Multiple IPs

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" (event_type=user_signed_in_* OR event_type="user_signed_in") | `claude_actor_email` | where isnotnull(actor_email) | stats dc(actor_ip_address) AS distinct_ips values(actor_ip_address) AS ips by actor_email | where distinct_ips > 1 | sort - distinct_ips

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" (event_type=org_sso_* OR event_type=org_jit_* OR event_type=org_domain_* OR event_type=org_user_deleted OR event_type=admin_api_key_* OR event_type=org_data_export_*) | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_email, actor_user_id, actor_ip_address, organization_id | sort - _time

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" event_type=file_uploaded | `claude_actor_email` | stats count latest(_time) AS last_upload by actor_email, claude_project_id | convert ctime(last_upload) | sort - count | head 20
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_type, actor_email, actor_ip_address, organization_id | sort - _time | head 50
